# GridPaw

> GridPaw is a free online platform for cat-themed Japanese logic puzzle games, playable in the browser with no download or sign-up. It also publishes unofficial fan-made walkthroughs, hints and answers for popular brain-puzzle mobile games (Brain Puzzle 3: Crazy Mind, Rotate Rings, Arrows Puzzle Escape, The Loop). Full expanded content: [llms-full.txt](https://gridpaw.com/llms-full.txt).

## Puzzle Games (play free)
- [Shikaku](https://gridpaw.com/): Drag to draw rectangles covering exactly the numbered cells. Classic Nikoli partition puzzle with cat visuals.
- [Akari (Light Up)](https://gridpaw.com/akari/): Place glowing cats to light every cell; numbered walls state adjacent cat counts. Pure logic, no guessing.
- [Kakuro (Cross Sums)](https://gridpaw.com/kakuro/): Fill runs so they sum to their clues with no repeated digits. 4-step tutorial, 11-level campaign, paw-print fog mode, daily puzzles.
- [Nonogram (Picture Logic)](https://gridpaw.com/nonogram/): Paint-by-number picture logic; every board single-solution and solver-verified. 4-step tutorial, 11-level campaign, daily puzzles.
- [Nurikabe (Islands and Sea)](https://gridpaw.com/nurikabe/): Grow numbered islands into a connected sea with no 2×2 sea blocks; solver-verified single solution.
- [Binary Puzzle (Takuzu)](https://gridpaw.com/binary/): Fill grids of 0/1 with no three-in-a-row and unique rows/columns. 6×6 to 10×10.
- [Hashi (Bridges)](https://gridpaw.com/hashi/): Connect every island with the right number of bridges, classic Hashiwokakero. 8×8 to 12×12.
- [KenKen / Calcudoku](https://gridpaw.com/kenken/): Cage arithmetic with no repeated digits in rows or columns; 4×4 to 9×9.
- [Slitherlink](https://gridpaw.com/slitherlink/): Draw one closed loop through numbered cells without crossings. 5×5 to 10×10.
- [Star Battle (Two Not Touch)](https://gridpaw.com/star-battle/): Place 2-3 stars per row, column and region without adjacent stars. 8×8 to 14×14.
- [Murdoku](https://gridpaw.com/murdoku/): Murder mystery sudoku variant — place cat suspects and follow witness statements to find the killer.
- [Meowdoku](https://gridpaw.com/meowdoku/): Cat-themed 6×6 sudoku-style logic with a fixed 10-level campaign, verified answers and star ratings.
- [Pictomino](https://gridpaw.com/pictomino/): Spatial reasoning for kids — drag and rotate cat puzzle pieces to fill grids from 3×3 to 5×5, with a daily puzzle.

## Tools
- [Nonogram Solver](https://gridpaw.com/nonogram/solver/): Free online nonogram solver with step-by-step deduction replay and shareable permalinks. Two-color boards, MRV-optimized.

## Walkthroughs & Answers (fan-made, unofficial)
- [Brain Puzzle 3: Crazy Mind — All Level Answers](https://gridpaw.com/brain-puzzle-3-answers/): Hub for level-by-level answers to Brain Puzzle 3 (Crazy Mind). Each level page has the exact task text, full step order and video timestamps — 50+ levels indexed.
- [Rotate Rings Guide — All Levels](https://gridpaw.com/rotate-rings/): Rotate Rings walkthrough hub; levels solved frame-by-frame with timed burst timestamps and mechanism notes.
- [The Loop — Answers & Strategy](https://gridpaw.com/the-loop-puzzle/): Daily guide for Britannica's The Loop picture puzzle: today's answer pointer, rules, color-feedback strategy and archive.
- [The Loop — Past Answers](https://gridpaw.com/the-loop-past-answers/): Archive of past The Loop daily answers, updated every day.
- [Arrows Puzzle Walkthrough](https://gridpaw.com/arrows-puzzle-walkthrough/): Complete walkthrough for Arrows – Puzzle Escape (Ecffri): strategy, stuck points and fixes, progression tips.
- [Arrows Puzzle Hub](https://gridpaw.com/arrows-puzzle/): What the arrows puzzle is, full rule breakdown, five beginner tips, FAQ.
- [Block Blast Hints](https://gridpaw.com/block-blast-hints/): 10+ Block Blast hints in three skill tiers, five common mistakes, high-score strategy loop.
- [Meowdoku Guide](https://gridpaw.com/meowdoku-guide/): Meowdoku (Oakever) strategy: six no-hint solving techniques, comparison of games like Meowdoku.
- [Cross Math Puzzle](https://gridpaw.com/cross-math-puzzle/): Cross math rules with operator symbols, six solving strategies, cross math vs Kakuro comparison.

## Learn
- [Japanese Logic Puzzles](https://gridpaw.com/japanese-logic-puzzles/): Overview of the main Japanese logic puzzle families and where to play them free.
- [Brain Teasers for Adults](https://gridpaw.com/brain-teasers-for-adults/): Logic brain teasers for adults: types, examples and daily practice.
- [Logic Puzzle Grid](https://gridpaw.com/logic-puzzle-grid/): How grid logic puzzles work and how to solve them step by step.
- [Number Grid Puzzle](https://gridpaw.com/number-grid-puzzle/): Number grid puzzle types (Kakuro, KenKen, cross math) with solving strategies.

## Features
- Free to play, no registration required
- Works on desktop, tablet, and phone
- Daily challenges with streak tracking
- Every board solver-verified (single solution)
